kurz: Everything you write to agents and everything they write to you is in one place. For each recipient you see how far a message has got – and as long as nobody has read it, you can withdraw it.
brauchst: The Workbench at the PC or the online site. Menu › Messages.

schritte.text: Messages › “+ Write” – pick a recipient (one agent or everyone), type, text. From an agent (“Message”) the recipient is already filled in.
“Sent” tab: per recipient sent › notified › read › done. Hover over a step to see the time.
Clicking a message shows the conversation on the right – your message and what came back. On a phone it opens as its own view (“‹ Back to list” returns).
“Inbox” tab: unread is bold. “Reply” writes back, the reference (e.g. the task) comes along; “Done” removes it from the count in the menu.
